name: common-fixes
tagline: Fix the most common @godxjp/ui consumer mistakes & visual bugs (StatCard double-border, grey Badge, crushed/empty table headers, washed-out sidebar footer, Inertia layout crash, SSR hydration). Before → after.

name: signup-form
tagline: Card-wrapped sign-up form using react-hook-form + zod with FormField/Input and a CardFooter action bar (real @godxjp/ui API).

name: settings-page-responsive
tagline: Route-backed settings: persistent desktop local navigation, compact mobile tab strip, deep links + browser history, and bounded form content — NO Card wrapper, NO undefined CSS.

name: settings-section-rows
tagline: The four canonical settings blocks — identity · preference rows · billing handoff · danger zone. Identity and billing are SECTIONS (Heading + Descriptions, no surface); preference rows and the danger zone are Cards because they are real boundaries. A COMPOSITION pattern: godx-ui ships no SettingsSection/SettingsRow/DangerZone component and never will.

name: pricing-plans
tagline: Pricing plan cards — ResponsiveGrid preset + Card featured + FeatureList + tabular price. A composition, not a component (consumer request, debated 2026-10-09 on #1205).

name: confirm-destructive
tagline: Type-to-confirm destructive dialog — the AlertDialog PRESET with `challenge` (the compound AlertDialog* parts are the older way in; a body the preset does not cover is Dialog variant="destructive").

name: dependent-selects
tagline: Country → state → city: three Selects where each child is disabled until its parent has a value (FormField helper says why), loading while its options fetch, and reset to "" when the parent changes. A composition, not a component — reach for Cascader only when it is ONE field.

name: card-grid-selection
tagline: Select cards in a grid and act on them in bulk — Card + Checkbox per item, the real DataTable.BulkActions driven by count outside a table, indeterminate select-all, AlertDialog before delete, toast with Undo after, EmptyState when nothing is left.

name: deferred-loading
tagline: Inertia deferred props with a Skeleton fallback — SkeletonTable while data loads, then DataTable (real @godxjp/ui API).

name: inertia-list-page
tagline: Inertia + @godxjp/ui list page — PageContainer + Toolbar (above the table) + DataTable + Badge + Pagination. No KPI row, no restating subtitle.

name: inertia-detail-page
tagline: Inertia detail page — receives {id} prop, Descriptions (compound) in one Card + EmptyState fallback. No KPI tile row.

name: inertia-persistent-layout
tagline: Inertia persistent layout (AppShell+Sidebar) — the array-form gotcha + the SSR/Math.random gotcha.

name: error-pages
tagline: 400 / 403 / 404 / 500 / 503 exception pages. USE THE COMPONENT: import { ErrorSurface } from "@godxjp/ui/layout". `mode="application"` (400/403/404) is the body you put inside the AppShell the route already renders; `mode="system"` (500/503) owns the page via CenteredShell align="center".

name: badge-coloring
tagline: Colour a Badge for a localized STATUS via tone + icon; tiers and categories take one neutral tone (colour means status).

name: async-data-state
tagline: The full async state machine — ONE primary state at a time: prerequisite, disabled-vs-loading, stale refresh, populated, real-empty, and cause-aware error (401/403/404/422/transient) with correct recovery.

name: data-table-page
tagline: Filter (Toolbar) + table surface + bottom pagination driven by a query state machine — pagination shows ONLY for successful multi-page data; filters/page survive a transient retry.

name: list-filters
tagline: A list page with MANY filters (cardinal rule #51) — FilterBar WRAPS; the 2–4 most-used filters stay inline, the rest sit behind ONE 'More filters' Button (count = hidden filters applied) that opens a Sheet; every applied filter is a removable chip. Never a sideways-scrolling strip.

name: organization-memberships
tagline: Workspace membership list — recognizable identity, current/active state, role, permission-aware Open/Switch/Manage/Leave row actions, page-level Create, and CONDITIONAL invitations (omit when none).

name: auth-recovery-panels
tagline: Signed-OUT password recovery + sign-in MFA challenge panels (SCR-008). There is NO PasswordRecoveryPanel and NO MfaChallengePanel — compose Card + AuthStack + FormField/InputOTP + Button inside CenteredShell variant="auth-canonical" preset="account-recovery" (the 432px token-owned measure).

name: account-recovery-settings
tagline: Signed-in recovery: compact method status/action rows (email · phone · backup codes) + a separate password-change destination — capability-aware, risk-appropriate, NO stacked Info Alerts.

name: transactional-email
tagline: Build a transactional HTML email (Blade/Twig/MJML/React) from @godxjp/ui/email — literal hex + px derived from the web tokens, the canonical GoDX brand mark, a bulletproof CTA, legal footer and mobile reflow. NEVER hand-copy hex or hand-draw the logo in a mail template.

name: page-sections
tagline: A page of several sections: a Heading + section spacing marks a section, not a Card. PageContainer spaces its direct children (section step); Flex gap spaces items inside one (item step). Card only for a real boundary.

name: topbar-account-chip
tagline: Signed-in user in a PageContainer `extra` slot: Avatar + name + sign-out as a Flex row of primitives — same control height as the buttons beside it. Never a hand-rolled rounded-full border div.

name: tenant-brand-color
tagline: Wear a CUSTOMER's own hex at runtime, scoped to one region — tenantTheme(hex) returns the token declarations plus the WCAG 2.2 AA label, so you never hand-roll hex→HSL or guess a foreground. There is no <TenantTheme> component and there should not be one.

name: brand-theme-block
tagline: Wear a WHOLE external brand — its palette, shape, type AND its motion spec — as one scoped theme block of token declarations. No forked components, no page-local overrides of library selectors. Use when you are handed a design system (Figma/HTML prototype/brand book), not a single customer hex.
